KINGDOM – Ting-Ting Chao × Anarchy Dance Theatre

ABOUT

Description

In the virtual world, space and time are fragmented, compressed, and stretched, as though transformed into layers of information waiting to be read. The body no longer occupies a fixed position, but instead drifts along the fault lines of dislocated memories, suspended somewhere between the physical and the virtual.

Living in an era of rapidly advancing internet and digital technologies, we have become accustomed to using various forms of media to capture and document the world around us. Yet amid this constant tide of technological change, KINGDOM invites audiences to look back at what has been left behind, overlooked, or rendered obsolete. The seemingly ordinary things we take for granted are often precisely those we fail to remember. In being forgotten, they gradually develop their own distinct character, colors, and warmth.

KINGDOM is an experimental, interdisciplinary XR performance created through a collaborative process. Integrating 3D scanning technology and motion capture systems within a VR environment, the work brings together fragmented imagery across multiple screens and the physical language of dancers. Through these elements, fragmented, liquefied, and incomplete 3D scans of objects are assembled into an uninhabited digital kingdom. Within this constantly collapsing and reconstructing digital landscape, the work explores an ongoing process of adaptation to new perceptions and ever-changing environments.
